# ApexCharts 8.8.2

Self-hosted browser bundle from https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/apexcharts@8.8.2/dist/apexcharts.min.js.

Radar configuration adapted from https://apexcharts.com/react-chart-demos/radar-charts/basic-radar/ using the native JavaScript API for this static HTML site. No React runtime is required.
